description: The limited-horizon Bellman update (LHB) improves a learned heuristic table with a short search, not with a single step. A *single-step Bellman update* sets a state's value to the best edge cost plus the neighbour's value; LHB looks further. It runs A* from a state for at most a fixed number of expansions, which gives a search graph of the generated states and edges, whose *leaves* are the states without children. Every other state gets the minimum, over the leaves it can reach, of the cheapest path cost to the leaf plus the leaf's old value, and goal states get 0. The crate computes this with one backward run of Dijkstra's algorithm from the leaves, offline (`lhb_update`) or as the learning step of the LSS-LRTA* agent (`lhb_lrta_star`), and from an admissible table the values stay admissible.

papers.authors: Gal Hadar, Forest Agostinelli, Shahaf S. Shperberg
papers.title: Beyond Single-Step Updates: Reinforcement Learning of Heuristics with Limited-Horizon Search
